package.name: wamv_manipulator_moveit_config
package.description: Milestone M3: MoveIt2 planning config for the vessel-mounted Panda arm. Reuses moveit_resources_panda_moveit_config's kinematics/ joint-limits/controller config unmodified; the only new content is an SRDF with the virtual joint corrected from a free-floating "world" base to a fixed mount on the vessel's own base link (see config/wamv_panda.srdf's header comment and docs/ros2.md).
